unlisted_practices: Clinicians should consider the risk of algorithmic bias when using or deploying AI-enabled tools in their practice.
Clinicians should seek information about datasets and evidence of performance when deploying AI-enabled tools in their practice.
Clinicians should continue to use their skills and judgment, including critical thinking and empathy, when using AI-enabled systems.
Clinicians should continue to challenge the myth that AI systems are completely objective and bias free.

screen.reason: An overview/commentary discussing algorithmic bias and the risks of deploying AI-enabled tools in clinical practice without empirical evaluation.
